items.evidence: Log lines 3-194: 48 samples each 250 uL with a fresh P1000 tip, from tubes into distinct wells A-H of columns 1,3,5,7,9,11; the same index is used for the elution column.
Sample is added first (log 3-194), then isopropanol (196-199), then beads (206-207), instead of beads, isopropanol, sample. The rest (5 mix, 300 s delay, magnet 240 s, 3x180 uL to waste) is correct.
Log 391-557: two 500 uL ethanol washes (3x166.667) from A9/A10 and A11/A12, each removed to waste with the magnet engaged. Then delay 240 s (558) and disengage (559) before elution.
Log 708-729 recovers 100 uL of eluate per column, not about 80 uL. Elution (100 uL, off-magnet, mix, 30 s delay, 90 s magnet) is otherwise correct.
Reagent order is changed, with sample added before beads and isopropanol. The agent also adds mixing in the bead reservoir (log 200-205) and recovers 100 uL rather than 80 uL.

judge.summary: The protocol handles samples correctly, with one fresh tip, one well and one elution well each. Washes, drying and the elution timings also match the paper. It fails on the binding order (sample added before beads and isopropanol), on recovering 100 uL instead of about 80 uL, and therefore on overall fidelity.
